queries: GPT-4 longer complex scenarios reasoning length benchmark FOLIO ProntoQA 2023

sources_considered.why: Versioned original GPT-4 report documents performance on established benchmarks.
Original GPT-4 evaluation compares short and full conversations and additional reasoning demands.
GPT-4's evaluated subset mainly tests information position at a fixed document count; FANToM more directly compares context lengths.
Read as corroboration, but the versioned technical report supplies more precise benchmark provenance.

evidence_items.explanation: The report gives GPT-4 scores of 86.4% on MMLU and 95.3% on HellaSwag, establishing that it solved many established benchmark items. These particular results concern the pretrained base model and do not independently establish deployed-model reliability.

evidence_items.locator: Section 4.1: Chain-of-thought and Fine-tuning; Reasoning Complexity; Short vs. Full Conversations; Tables 2 and 9
evidence_items.explanation: FANToM tested GPT-4-0314 and GPT-4-0613, finding remaining failures, worse performance with full conversations, and lower scores on binary questions requiring an additional reasoning step. Step-by-step prompting helped, and the complexity pattern was not consistent across every question format.

unresolved_gaps: The studies do not establish a universal relationship between length, complexity and failure across all task families.
Established-benchmark scores and conversation experiments use different evaluation settings.
